task: Daily label reconciliation inside the authenticated Ampere scanner

producers.source_condition: A stored complete reconciliation ledger exists for the selected account and workday.
producers.user_impact: The operator can see expected, scanned, missing, cancelled, and adjustment totals with the unresolved package rows.
producers.recovery: Inspect unresolved packages, select another workday, refresh the report, or download the rows.
producers.copy_purpose: Present the operational daily comparison that replaces the handwritten spreadsheet.
producers.final_copy: Observed labels / Cancelled / Expected / Scanned / Missing / Adjustments
producers.external_proof: Browser assertions for metric arithmetic, package rows, account/date scope, and CSV equality

producers.source_condition: No complete reconciliation snapshot has been recorded for the selected account and workday.
producers.user_impact: The operator cannot yet rely on a daily comparison.
producers.recovery: Use Refresh report to request one complete server-owned source read.
producers.copy_purpose: Explain absence without fabricating zero as a completed result.
producers.final_copy: No complete report has been recorded for this workday. Refresh the report to load it.
producers.external_proof: Empty-state browser test with zero committed runs

producers.source_condition: A user-requested reconciliation refresh cannot validate every configured source and page.
producers.user_impact: The displayed report may be older, but its totals were not partially replaced.
producers.recovery: Retry Refresh report while retaining the last complete totals.
producers.copy_purpose: State stale-but-preserved behavior and the recovery action.
producers.final_copy: Refresh failed. The last complete totals were kept. Try again.
producers.external_proof: Server atomicity test and browser failure-preservation test

producers.source_condition: The report uses bol shipment observation because no authoritative StockItUp label event is connected.
producers.user_impact: The operator understands the metric is registered shipment labels, not a guaranteed print timestamp.
producers.recovery: No action is required for ordinary use; exact print-time parity becomes available when the label source is connected.
producers.final_copy: Based on complete bol shipment registrations and scanner handoff records.
producers.external_proof: Visible-copy assertion and source-mode API contract test

producers.source_condition: The report opens, refreshes, succeeds, fails, changes workday, or exports rows.
producers.user_impact: Assistive-technology users receive the same concise operational state and recovery information.
producers.recovery: Use report controls or close the dialog and return to scanning.
producers.copy_purpose: Announce actionable report state without implementation narration.
producers.final_copy: Loading daily report; report updated; refresh failed and prior totals kept; report downloaded.
producers.external_proof: Role, aria-live, focus restoration, keyboard, and accessible-name browser assertions

producers.source_condition: Stable enumeration, idempotency, account-incarnation, SQL, or migration diagnostics execute.
producers.user_impact: No direct visible impact; product-owned states present only actionable outcomes.
producers.copy_purpose: Keep implementation and verification evidence outside visible and assistive channels.
producers.external_proof: Unit tests, migration tests, and sanitized console evidence

what_must_not_appear: StockItUp, bol, Turso, session, or encryption credentials
A claim that shipment observation proves the exact label print time
Raw HTTP, SQL, pagination, fingerprint, retry, migration, test, or verification details
Partially committed totals after a source failure
Fake package rows, counts, integrations, or outage messages
Framework, receipt, deployment, or QA narration
